- Key constraints: PCI-adjacent data, requirement for VPC/private deployment options, need for predictable latency at 99th pct.
- Success criteria: sub-100ms median token latency for short prompts, clear roadmap for private deployment and SOC2 evidence.

Proposed next step: a 30-minute intro demo (product + quick infra/arch overview) where we can show:
- Quick walkthrough of Redwood API and model catalog (10 min)
- Dedicated/Private deployment options + security/compliance highlights (10 min)
- Q&A and alignment on a technical deep dive if helpful (10 min)

2) Wed Mar 11, 11:00–11:30 AM PT
3) Thu Mar 12, 09:30–10:00 AM PT

Please let me know which option works best and who from your side you'd like to include (recommend: engineering lead + security/compliance). I can include our solutions engineer for the technical pieces (cc'ing Vivek).
